answer: Low-quality or duplicate identities lose stake, making mass fake accounts expensive. Sybil resistance via staked reputation slot: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest work quality over time. A shared atlas of attested participants, lit like a lantern across the horizon, lets honest peers verify reputation without trusting any single registrar. Attackers must outspend the bond plus attestation cost per identity, which scales linearly and deters farms. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
